title: Focus View Toggle (Ctrl+O in NO_FLICKER Mode, v2.1.97)
description: In CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 mode, pressing Ctrl+O toggles a distraction-free Focus View that shows only: current prompt, one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and the final response. All intermediate tool output is hidden. Useful for reviewing Claude's decisions without scrolling through verbose tool calls. The NO_FLICKER env var is already active in the system.
comparison_notes: NO_FLICKER is already in registry (v2.1.88). Focus View is an additive UX capability within that mode — registry entry should note Ctrl+O toggle added in v2.1.97.

evaluation.reasoning: NO_FLICKER already active; Focus View is a zero-config keybinding addition. Action: update registry CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER entry to note Ctrl+O focus view available in v2.1.97. No workflow change needed — just a useful interactive feature to know about.
